verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation SDK, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack never documents a Stagehand CLI. The quickstart, the MCP/stdio integration for Claude Code and the AI-rules pages are different capabilities (an SDK setup, an MCP server, and coding-assistant config), not an official command-line tool, so none of them count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
